# North Kenilworth Veterinary Care

> A comprehensive veterinary clinic in Phoenix's Willo District offering preventive medicine, surgical services, diagnostics, grooming, training, and emergency referrals for companion animals.

North Kenilworth Veterinary Care is a full-service veterinary hospital located at 342 W. McDowell Road in Phoenix, Arizona. The clinic provides a wide range of medical, surgical, and wellness services for pets, supported by experienced veterinarians and staff.

## Key Topics

- Veterinary Surgery
- Preventive Medicine
- Animal Diagnostics
- Pet Grooming
- Vaccinations
- Spaying & Neutering
- Pet Health App
- Phoenix, Arizona
- Small Animal Care
- Dental Care
- Pet Training
- Pharmacy Services
- Pet Nutrition
- Emergency Referrals
- Willo District

## Core Veterinary Services

- [Veterinary Care](https://northkenilworthvet.com/service): Comprehensive veterinary services overview including surgery, grooming, pharmacy.
- [Preventive Medicine](https://northkenilworthvet.com/preventive-veterinary-medicine): Preventive veterinary medicine services including vaccinations and parasite control.
- [Animal Diagnostics](https://northkenilworthvet.com/animal-diagnostics): Diagnostic services including blood testing, X-rays, and disease screening.
- [Veterinary Surgery](https://northkenilworthvet.com/veterinary-surgery): Surgical services including spaying, neutering, and soft tissue procedures.
- [Pet Nutrition](https://northkenilworthvet.com/service/nutrition): Pet nutrition guidance and diet recommendations for weight management.
- [Pharmacy](https://northkenilworthvet.com/service/pharmacy): On-site pharmacy dispensing medications and preventative care products.

## Additional Pet Services

- [Pet Grooming Services](https://northkenilworthvet.com/pet-grooming-services): Professional pet grooming services including nail trimming and ear cleaning.
- [Pet Trainers](https://northkenilworthvet.com/pet-trainers): Pet training services for obedience, behavior, and puppy training.
